nodes.label: Bake COGNITO_/NEXTAUTH_/AGENT_RUNTIME_ARN/CHAT_ACTOR_ID env vars into .env.production
nodes.rationale: Amplify Hosting's Lambda-based SSR runtime does not reliably expose these process env vars at server request time, so the build filters the environment for the COGNITO_, NEXTAUTH_, AGENT_RUNTIME_ARN, and CHAT_ACTOR_ID prefixes and appends them to .env.production before `pnpm build`, letting Next.js bake them into the build output/required-server-files.json (see repo commits 'Bake server env vars into required-server-files.json for Amplify Lambda' and 'Fix chat route env var fallbacks broken by env config baking').
